# Test fixture provenance

Nothing here is scraped, recorded from a real call, or taken from a real person. All people, organisations
and numbers are invented, and every phone number sits in the fictional block `(NXX) 555-01xx` unless the
file is an explicit negative case.

| Fixture | Authored how | Used by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scenarios/ok/**` | Hand-written for the loader and timeline tests. A small scam call with one reply branch, and a short legitimate call. | `loader.test.ts`, `timeline.test.ts` | Organisation names are "Test ..." so they can never be mistaken for real content. |
| `scenarios/broken/**` | Hand-written. Every defect is deliberate (two asks, an unknown `goto`, an undeclared variable, an unknown source, a real-looking number, an unknown field). | `loader.test.ts` | The test asserts `file:line` messages, finding each line by searching the file. |
| `scoring.json` | Hand-written from the SPEC section 7.2 table, one row per table row plus the boundaries at `tFlag`, `tAsk`, `tAsk + 10 s` and `tEnd`. Not generated from the implementation. | `scoring.test.ts` | Markers are fixed so a failing row points at the rule, not at the data. |
| `dates.ts` | Hand-written. The 2026 US and EU daylight-saving transitions, a week boundary, a year end, and a Chicago to Kolkata traveller. Instants were converted by hand and checked against the zone rules. | `dates.test.ts`, `streak.test.ts` | |
| `links/v1-*.txt` | Generated **once** by `links/generate-v1.ts` from the v1 payload shapes in SPEC section 9, then committed. **Never regenerate.** They pin the wire format: every future release must keep decoding them. | `links.test.ts` | `v1-bad-*` are hostile or damaged on purpose (AC-F8-7). The inflate bomb is a 300 KB run of spaces compressed to a few hundred bytes. |
| `cheers/cheer-opus.webm`, `cheer-aac.m4a` | Generated by `cheers/make.sh`: one second of a 440 Hz sine tone with a fade, mono, 12 kbps. Not a human voice. | `links.test.ts`, `recorder.test.ts` | They prove container handling and link size, not audio quality. |
| `audio-manifest.json` | Hand-written placeholder with no clips. Durations used in tests come from inline maps in each test. | `manifest.test.ts` | Unit tests never depend on the rendered audio in `public/audio`. |
| `names/real.txt`, `names/fictional.txt` | Hand-written. `real.txt` quotes well-known institutions only to prove the deny-list catches them. `fictional.txt` holds the coined names plus ordinary words that merely resemble deny-list terms. | `names.test.ts` | |

The production library in `scenarios/` is also exercised as a fixture by `library.test.ts`: it is real content,
authored by hand against SPEC section 5, and every test run validates it.
